_comment: Item condition (docs/draft/degradation-system.md §4–§5). durability.defaults: wear points an item takes from pristine to ruined, by item type (or "shield"). An item's own "durability": {"max": N} wins; "durability": false, quest items, ammunition and thrown-only weapons don't wear. Weapons wear 1 per damaging hit (2 on a crit); armour 1 per hit taken, on one worn piece (body, then legs, then shield). Tiers by durability left: Pristine 75%+, Worn 50%+ (-10% damage, -1 AC), Damaged 25%+ (-25%, -2 AC), Ruined (-50%, half its AC). repair: field repair (whetstone, crafting kit) only brings gear back up to Worn (field_up_to: the share of durability left it restores to); smiths, by NPC id, repair the materials they work, at cost x the item's value x the share of wear they mend, plus a material per 25% of wear mended where they want one. materials: what anything not listed is made of is metal. water: where a waterskin can be filled (degradation §7): every town (wells, inns), and these wild places (coast, swamp, forest streams).
